text:
liz: FYI billing just flagged several tenants with charge deltas after last week's deploy. Digging in shows meter tags have mixed api_version values (header vs resolved).
omar: Ugh. We talked about this during the v2 rollout but I thought we already switched emitters to use resolved_version. Did the change not land everywhere?
jia: Only the gateway emitter was changed. The pod-level meter emitter (in runtime) still tags using incoming header. That creates splits when policy resolution overrides header.
liz: Repro snippet: request header X-Client-Version=v2 -> routing resolved_version=v1 (route meta override) -> meter tag api_version=v2 (header) => billing attributes mismatch. Trace id a1b2c shows this.
trent: That explains the invoice delta for tenant T-314. Billing counts 70% v2 (header) but runtime decisions were 70% v1.
omar: Fix plan: 1) emergency patch to pod emitter to read resolved_version (small change), 2) deploy canary to 5% traffic, 3) run backfill to correct aggregated metrics for last 3 days.
jia: Backfill approach: use routing-decisions events (they contain resolved_version once we emit it) to re-emit aggregated meter records into the billing pipeline. We need to be careful with idempotency.
liz: Important: the routing-decisions stream currently only has resolved_version for new events. We need to land the earlier telemetry change (emit resolved_version) in the next deploy before backfill runs, otherwise backfill won't have the source-of-truth.
omar: Order of ops: (A) land pod emitter change, (B) deploy routing-decisions field resolved_version emitter, (C) run backfill job to re-tag historical meter aggregates using routing stream, (D) notify billing and support.
trent: For safety, backfill job should write to a staging billing index first and we compare totals. Also include a dry-run mode that only computes diffs.
jia: I'll write the backfill job. Needs an elasticsearch read of routing-decisions joined by trace_id -> then rewrite aggregated meter rows. We'll include a checksum to avoid duplicate application.
liz: Policy note: we should add a lint in CI that ensures all meter emitters reference the canonical resolution API rather than raw headers. Catches future drift.
omar: Also add an integration test where header!=route meta and assert meter tag equals resolved_version.
jia: I'll PR INF-5123 with the backfill plan and tests.
billing-bot: New ticket created: INF-5123 (billing-backfill-resolved-version) assigned to @jia @omar.
liz: Communication: we'll send a short note to finance and account owners for impacted tenants with corrected numbers once the backfill completes. Keep it transparent.
trent: One more: console should display both the declared config (route meta) and runtime-resolved version. Add a toggle view for "billing view" that shows meter-tagged version.
omar: Agreed. That will help support reconcile.
liz: ETA: pod emitter patch in 2 hours, routing emit change in the next deploy (today), backfill dry-run after deploy, full run tomorrow morning.
jia: I'll kick off the dry-run once routing emits are available.
liz: Thanks team. We'll review results in the postmortem channel after backfill. :white_check_mark:
